basic_details.job_title: KVIC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Technical Expert, Marketing Expert & Other Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC), under the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Government of India, is inviting applications for Technical Expert, Marketing Expert and Retired Bank Official posts at its State Office, Guwahati (Assam). The engagement is on contract basis for the period up to 31 March 2027, and the last date to apply is 21 November 2026. Details of qualification, experience, job description, remuneration and age limit are published on www.kvic.gov.in.

how_to_apply: Applications must be made on or before 21 November 2026. The notice does not describe the application mode or the steps; it refers applicants to www.kvic.gov.in for further details. Queries can be sent to the State Office, Guwahati at [email protected] or by phone on 0361-2465449.
important_instructions: The engagement is on contract basis for the period up to 31 March 2027. The contract may be extended for a further period upon the performance of the selected candidates. Details of qualification, experience, job description, remuneration and age limit are available on www.kvic.gov.in. The issuing office is the KVIC State Office, Rupnagar, Guwahati (Assam)-781032.

content_sections.text: The notice itself does not specify the number of vacancies, the age limit, the pay, the application fee or the selection process; it states that qualification, experience, job description, remuneration and age limit details are on www.kvic.gov.in .

content_sections.heading: About KVIC
content_sections.text: The Khadi and Village Industries Commission is a body under the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Government of India. This recruitment is conducted by its State Office at Rupnagar, Guwahati (Assam)-781032, which can be contacted at 0361-2465449 or [email protected] . The notice is signed by the Dy. CEO, State Office, Guwahati.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice names three posts. It does not print the number of vacancies for any of them.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications from interested applicants for the three posts. The qualification, experience, job description, remuneration and age limit for each post are not printed in this notice; the notice directs applicants to www.kvic.gov.in for these details. The post name "Retired Bank Official" indicates the post is meant for retired bank officials, but the specific eligibility conditions for it are also given only on the website. Candidates should check the official notification and the KVIC website for the post-wise eligibility of each post.

The notice does not describe the application mode or the steps; it refers applicants to www.kvic.gov.in for further details. Queries can be sent to the State Office, Guwahati at [email protected] or by phone on 0361-2465449.
